preserved_outcome_markers.error: create_env() got an unexpected keyword argument 'rendering_type'

false_success_finding.finding: Every pod marked Succeeded in the preserved snapshot also wrote an infrastructure_failure.json marker. Isaac application teardown terminated the child process with exit status 0 after the runner selected its failure return code.
false_success_finding.remediation: Run the Isaac seed runner as a child of a non-Isaac marker-check process; the parent requires a passing g2_seed_receipt.json, rejects any infrastructure_failure.json, and propagates failure independently of Isaac teardown.

root_cause.detail: The V4 adapter used the unsupported keyword rendering_type and the RTX mode value RayTracedLighting. The pinned RoboLab create_env contract requires rendering_mode and renderer=realtime.

disposition: No G2 seed passed. The attempt is retained as infrastructure evidence only and must not be counted as behavioral failure or G2 completion.
